material.acceptance_criteria: a CI run spawns a unit through a mod, reloads the data, and the mod's handle still orders the same unit.
material.description: The data swap clears the room's handle map, so a mod's handles stop resolving after a reload even though the carried units keep their indices. Remap handles to the carried indices instead of clearing them.
material.resolution: A mod's handle keeps working across a data reload: a unit removed by the new map is placed back at its original index with spawn_at, so the handle still orders it. CI checks the unit moves and no unmapped refusal is logged. Gaps filed: a handle is kept when any unit is alive at the index even if its kind changed; a handle whose kind is absent from the new catalog is dropped silently.
material.subject: Keep mod unit handles across a data reload
material.witness: ci-status run 38917049830 job mod handle survives a data reload; arrays.rs 541-566; room.rs 385-400
